_about: Answer key for the test story in eval/story. 'planted' are real mistakes the system SHOULD flag; 'decoys' look like changes but are fine and should NOT be flagged. A flag matches an item when it was raised while checking that chapter, its entity contains one of 'entity_contains', and one of 'keywords' appears in its values, quotes or explanation.

planted.description: Ines's eyes: grey (ch1) vs green (ch4). Uses a different name, 'Keeper Calloway'.
Tobias is Ines's older brother (ch1) but her younger brother (ch5).
The Merrow is red-painted (ch2) but has a blue hull (ch5).
Rudd has a long white beard (ch2) but a clean-shaven chin (ch6). Uses 'Harbourmaster Rudd'.
Pip is ten (ch3) but twelve (ch6), within one autumn.
Bramble dies (ch3) but barks at gulls (ch5).
Tobias lost his left hand (ch2) but claps both hands over a latch (ch4).
The brass key is thrown into the sea (ch3) but used to unlock the lamp room (ch6).
Rudd spent the whole storm night in the harbour office (ch4) but rowed out to the Gullstone that night (ch5).
Ines has kept the light twenty years (ch1) but eight years (ch5).
The storm broke on Tuesday (ch4) but was 'on Friday' (ch6).
Tobias arrived three days before the storm (ch2) but the morning after it (ch5).

decoys.description: Ines moves into the village for winter: a normal change of location over time.
Pip's sprained ankle (ch3) heals by the end of the week (ch5): recovery, not a contradiction.
Ines cuts her wrist (ch4) and it's bandaged (ch5): consistent.
